title: Pay National Guarantee Fund levies
what: Levies in respect of the National Guarantee Fund are imposed as the Act and the regulations provide.

sources.title: Corporations (National Guarantee Fund Levies) Act 2001
sources.quote: 4 Imposition of levies in respect of National Guarantee Fund The following levies are imposed by this Act: (a) any levy that is payable under section 889J of the Corporations Act 2001; (b) any levy that is payable under section 889K of the Corporations Act 2001.
